rationale: GABA conductance scan under SEClamp toward paper PD 12.5 / ND 30 nS is a deposited-code calibration step. Now that the project's primary substrate is the from-scratch minimal DSGC (t0052, t0053), this calibration is no longer urgent. The from-scratch model uses paper-aligned GABA scaling natively (gabaMOD) or spatial-asymmetric mechanism, so no SEClamp-derived calibration is needed. Keep at medium priority.
